title: Relay connection claims
responsibility: Reads syntactically valid host or device connection claims from request headers.

inputs.name: connectClaims.headers
inputs.description: A Web Headers instance from which the function reads Authorization, role, and device headers; it checks the Bearer credential before the role. It never looks for a credential in a URL.

outputs.name: connectClaims
outputs.description: The claims object returned when the Bearer credential matches the remote credential pattern and the headers identify a host or a valid device. Host claims have an empty deviceId; device claims retain the validated device ID, and all other cases return undefined.
